name: Onfleet
summary: Last-mile delivery management platform with a documented Route Optimization API: a caller schedules an optimization over tasks and teams, starts the engine, polls status and applies the result. The optimization endpoint takes a required maximum allowed delay and an objective mode (minimize distance, always on time, or balance the two), and the v3 engine takes a published per-parameter cost model instead. This version claims `scm.optimize-delivery-routes` on those parameters. The optimization endpoints are Enterprise-plan only.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-14, no credentials: GET onfleet.com/api/v2/organization 401 InvalidCredentials, no www-authenticate; the API key is the Basic-auth username. mcp.onfleet.com/mcp answers 401 with resource_metadata, full OAuth discovery and a registration endpoint, and is in no vendor doc.

jobs.summary: Claimed on the vendor's API reference for the optimization endpoint, not marketing: the required `mode` offers "0 for Minimize Distance Driven", "1 for Always on Time" and "3 for Balance Driving distance and Timely Arrival", and `maxViolationTime` is required: "Max allowed delay time, in minutes".
